title: Type hints and dataclasses

spans.text: Type hints communicate expected values to readers and static tools; Python does not enforce them during ordinary execution. dataclass reduces boilerplate for simple data objects.

spans.code: No console output; defines Point(x: float, y: float).

spans.text: dataclass reduces boilerplate for data classes.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Type hints are not input validation; validate untrusted network and file data separately.
